translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Mika taaju puindu puulanu

Lala ura' mideeyu juntsa pure' chachilla uwain tsaave tya' keenguemula, naa tituba de-i' taaju kes jinduba, Diosnun keengues jintsumuwa deeñuba. Tsa' mitya laa bain tyee lalanu bulla kikeñungue' jeke ujcha lawaawaake' tsaa tanamuñuba, juntsanu demangasha' pukeñungue', daran nemula juuñuu dyatyumujchi ajkesha jisai.

Lalaya Jesús naajuwaañuba juntsanaa keetadi' juntsaaya jusai, matyu ya' mityaa keengues jintsu' uwain tsaave tyantsunu dejuyu, ya' mityaa Dios naajusa tyamuñuba juntsaa tiyanu dejuyu. Kuusanu tu'vi' naa mayujpeyaiñu-i' tuta'ba tsaikutya' puimuwaave, matyu yaa naa tsamantsa taaju ke' pulla'ba, bene sunden chunu ju'ba miwa' mitya, tsejtu Diosa' chunu keesha urandyasha chuve.
Tsa' mitya Jesúsya naa-i' ujcha lamu chachillachi tituba pakaya' na'baasa imuwaañuba juntsanu keetadi' pensanguidei. Tsaju' tyubaiñu-i' ipijpajtyaiñui bain ityudei,
matyu ñullaya naa keengue' jindu bain chaikamaba firu' kemulachi tituba de-i' peyainuuya indetyu' mitya.
Tsaaren Dios ñullanu ya' na juuñungue kure' ulemuwaañuba, ¿yumaa juntsa demanbashiitu deiyu? Matyu Diosa' Kiikanu entsandimuwaave:

content.text: Ñu, in na, naa nepañuba, ipijpajtyaiñuuya ityude, tive.
Bale Rukuya munu estya'ba matse'kaamuve urajdetushu juntsaa,
tsenmin ya naajulanu ya' na tirenu mika'ba urajtu kemulanuya taaju ikaamuve.

content: Diosya ñullanu ya' na kuretaa tsangue' taaju iware' puitentsuve, ñulla urajdetuñu matse'karendu. Tsejtu ¿mallee ya' apala ya' nalanu nepa' matse'kaatyuba dejun?
Tsejtu ñulla urajdetunuren Dios kumuinchi ya' nalanu naake matse'kaamu ju' bain, ñullanu juntsangue' matse'kaatyuñuya, ñulla yachi ura ya' na keengaya jun dejutyuve.

Tsenmin lala kayinu tinbutala entsa tusha lala' apala lala urajdetuñu matse'kaakaa dekiñu bain, yalanu ura' keeware' meenguemu deeyu. Tsa' mitya ¿kayu naajutaa ura lala' Apa selusha chumunaa meengui'nu dejuwa, tsa-i' ura' chunu?

Lala' apala entsa tusha chungama matse'karen chumuwa deeve, yaichi naakeñu urañuba tsa tsanguendu, tsaanuren lala urajdetuñu, Dios mantse'kaamiya laachi uwain uraanuu kitaa tsanguemuve, tsangue' ya naaju'ba juntsaa chumu tirenu.
Uwain tyee ke' ura' mantse'kaanu kidekiñu bain tsa dekenu uwanuya tsaa mujtyu' sunden pensa kukaatyuve, tsaaren nenñaa tsa dekiñuba aseetangue' mijashu juntsaa, tiba bulla jutyu ura' chunu tiremuve.
Tsa' mitya, Dios ñullanu ura' mantse'karendu taaju i' puitekarentsuñuba, benga' tyullaiñu ityu', ura' mandeeladei.
Tsejtu, na'baasa ken chunañu dena'ba, ura' juuya mangue' miidei,
tsenmalaa ura' ken chutyula, janga' neiñuu imula kayu firu' ken chutyu', ura' manguemu tiyanudetsu.
Diosnu keengue' jintsusai.
Ñulla kumuinchi naa-uwanuba ura, ti peletuba tajtu nejuu chudei, tsejtu Dioschin juu chunu kidei. Tsa jutyushu juntsaya, naake' Bale Rukunu katan tsa deeve.

Munu bain Diosnu keengue' ura' is jintsuren manbaka' me-ere', Dios estya' keeware' ura' kiikenutala mandyalla kikaanu kityudei, tsejtaa mu bain chi telele ne saa jun tsaju' pure' chachillanu defiru' iwaakenu jui'nudetsu.

Ñulla mu bain mu'baasa ne tsa tsaimu tiyanu kityudei, tsenmin Esaú tsaaya tiba Dioschin juu jumunu balenguutyu jutyudei; matyu yaa, ma panda palatu' mityaren avenju na jutu naa naa-i uraa inu ju'ba juntsa tsaa atikeñunguive.
Tsenmin ñulla mideeve tsanguetu bene, ya' apachi ura' iinuu tikayanu keñuren, naaken tsaa juwaañuba, tsejtu naamika pure' warendi' bain, ya tsanguemuwaatu naaken tsaa tiyamuwaañuba.
Ñullaya kaspele Israel chachilla tsaaya entsa tusha chumu Sinaí kuyinu, naa ñi bain llukikentsu, naa tsamantsa yajuuna, naa ishuwa bain jelekinguentsu kalen jindetyuve,
naa juipunu tyujtyu ui'kakara bain, naa Diosa' pañu palaa bain merendetyuve. Jumala meemulaya ne jungajte pa' jijiintsusa tyatyuwa deeve,
Dios entsanguidei tiñu tsamantsa dejeetyatu: Mun kuyinu jayu tyulla'kañuba shupukachi tene tya'ke' tu'nu dejuve, naa animaa tsaiñu bain,
timuwaañu' mitya.
Tsenñu tsamantsa uu jeetyanu' kentsuñu' mitya, Moisésren entsandimuwaami: Jelanchin depi'shi kentsuyu,
timuwaami.

Ñullaa juntsa Sinaí kuyi keesha jityumujchi, Sión kuyi keeshaa jiiñu deive, matyu chumu Diosa' pebulusha, selusha jumu Jerusalén pebulusha. Junaa tsamantsa pure' anjeela sundya' Diosnu aawa kurenu debuudi' puinshaa jiiñu deive,

tsenmin Diosa' nala, ajke' kayamu na juuñuu tene jude' mitya, ti bain Dios kuwanu tsuyu tiñu juntsa tadiyanuu jumula selusha yala' mumu depilla' kayaa jumula' chu' wa'nanushaa ñulla kalen jiiñu deive. Tsenmin munuba kavitu kemu, Diosa' jungaa ñulla kalen jiiñu deive, jungaa Dioschi ura' kemu kuramula Dios naajusa tyañuba tsaa tiyamula' chuinshave.

Naa Jesús' chuinsha bain kalen jiiñu deive, ya' mityaa Dios chachillaba veta' veta' manen tsanguedaa tiñu tsanguikaamu' junga. Lala ya' asachee Dioschi ura' kuraa demandiyayu. Tsa' mitya juntsa asa Abel' asanuba kayu pullake ura' kemuve, matyu tutamu Abel' asaya chachiitala veta' firu' mangaanu pensa tene ne kuwakemuñu' mitya.

Tsa' mitya Bale Ruku panmala meenguenu keenadei, matyu entsa tunu Sinaí kuyisha naakidei tiñuba tsanguityulaya taaju i' puimuwa deeve. Tsaañu' mitya lalanu kai'sha selusha papuñuren meenguityulaya uwain kayu taaju i' pullanbera inu dejuyu.

Jumaa tinbunu Dios pañuren, tu depi'shikemuwaave, tsaaren challaya entsanguenbera kenu tsuyu tive: Kama bijee manbi'shikaanu tsuyu, tsaaren umaa turen jujutyu, naa selusha tiba jenamulanu bain dejuikikaanu tsuyu,
tive.

“Kama bijee” titu, aseetanguikaamiya ti bain de-i' faawaramula katawa deishu juntsa dejuiketu, vee mujtu de-era' tsaa demanbirainu tsuve ti' aseetanguikaataa tsandive, tsenmalaa juiken jutyuularen tsana shuwainudetsu.

Dios laachi rei tiya' washkentsuñu, yumaa kangumadenaashu juntsaya juiken jutyuve. Tsa' mitya Diosnu mika urave ti' aawa kure' keewaasai, yanu tsamantsa balengure' keeware' naaketaa ura' tyawaasa tyamuñuba juntsanguendu.
Matyu lala' Diosya ñi juuñu ju' tibilla bain de-ikakaakeñungue' piremu juve.
